releases.title: Home page now shows gameplay
notes: The home page now plays a silent gameplay clip behind the title, so you can see the action before you press start.

releases.title: Under-the-hood updates
notes: Improvements and fixes.

releases.title: Online matches run smoother
notes: Quitting on the VS screen before the fight starts no longer costs you rating.
Online matches no longer drop to the results screen with a "Connection lost" message before the fight begins.
The sky clouds in Rainbow Full Pipe now show up instead of going missing.

releases.title: Online matches keep running in the background
notes: Online matches keep going when you switch to another tab or app.
If you stay away and press nothing for a short while, your online match ends as a give-up.

releases.title: Online play now runs on Hawkes Net
notes: Online matches now run through Hawkes Net.
Leaderboard records now come from Hawkes Net.
The searching chip no longer hides the Back button or the title on Character Select.
Online menus leave room under the searching chip, so nothing sits behind it.
Your own row now appears only once on the leaderboard.

releases.title: Open Mic episode out tonight
notes: The latest episode of the show, Open Mic, goes live tonight.
Exit Punk drops in for a quick walk-on, rolling by on his one skateboard.

releases.title: New episode and loading screen voice
notes: A new episode of the show, Open Mic, is out tonight.
Exit Punk makes a walk-on in Open Mic, riding his one skateboard.
The "A versus B" voice call on the loading screen now plays on time.

releases.title: Improvements and fixes
notes: Improvements and fixes.

releases.title: Behind-the-scenes updates
notes: Improvements and fixes.

releases.title: Smoother Mesa and clearer touch buttons
notes: Foreground smoke on Dust Devil Mesa is lighter, so you can see your fighter and the ground more clearly.
The on-screen touch buttons are easier to make out against busy backgrounds.
Stages and knockout effects load ahead of time during the VS screen, so the fight starts with less waiting.

releases.title: Improvements and fixes
notes: Improvements and fixes.

releases.title: Profile pictures show in full
notes: Profile pictures now show in full instead of being cut off at the edges.

releases.title: Menu fits smaller screens, and music is back
notes: The main menu now fits on 720p screens, so no entries get cut off at the bottom.
A background music track that was missing now plays as it should.

releases.title: Multiplayer rooms, a leaderboard, and smoother play
notes: Multiplayer puts everyone in one shared room, with a queue for players waiting to get in.
A leaderboard now ranks multiplayer players.
On-screen touch controls show up during matches, and double-tapping to block no longer gets in the way of them.
Sound now works on phones, with a tap to turn it on and a new Settings menu.
Frames stay smoother with fewer stutters, and the dark flashes between the title screen, menus and match exit are gone.

releases.title: Season one is on the air
notes: The full roster steps into the ring: every fighter is playable in Versus and Training.
The Campaign airs in eight chapters, from Open Mic to Encore.
Keyboard or gamepad, right in your browser.
